text:
Maya: Heads-up team — Acme POC is hitting repeated 429s on /v1/embeddings.batch during a bulk import. They say it started ~10:12am PST and is blocking the demo prep. They included a small log snippet. Can we triage quickly?

Jon: @Maya can you paste the customer request size (# of items) and whether they’re using parallel workers? Also which model/variant they’re calling.

Maya: They sent this sample: 3 concurrent workers, each sending batches of 512 items. Model: embed-large-v2. Tenant id: acme-demo-01.

Sam: Ok 3x512 is a lot for embeddings in a short window. Can you paste the log snippet? Also do we know if they’re hitting per-route caps or overall tenant token budget?

Maya: Here’s the snippet they pasted:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: 2026-03-21T17:12:13Z
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "Rate limit exceeded",
  "code": "rate_limit",
  "retry_after_ms": 1200,
  "route": "/v1/embeddings.batch",
  "tenant_id": "acme-demo-01",
  "tokens": 120000
}
```

Jon: That retry_after looks like our standard per-route response. Two immediate hypotheses: 1) per-route burst window exhausted (per-route token-burst) or 2) tenant-level token budget hit because batches are large.

Sam: Agree. Quick checks:
- Check console -> Traffic -> Per-tenant token usage for last 5m for acme-demo-01.
- Check console -> Routes -> /v1/embeddings.batch -> per-route quota/burst settings.
- If they’re sending many concurrent heavy batches, we may want a temporary per-route override.

Jon: If you want to triage without changing config: ask the customer to reduce concurrency to 1 worker and batch size to 128 (for a few minutes) to confirm it’s quota-related. If 429s stop, it proves it.

Maya: I asked them and they’re willing to try a reduced concurrency test now. I’m also asking for timestamps of failed requests.

ops-bot: [automated] Route override request template: POST /internal/admin/overrides {"tenant_id":"<id>","route":"<route>","tokens_per_min":<n>,"duration_min":<m>} — requires infra approval.

Sam: If we need a hotfix, I can apply a short override: tokens_per_min = 300000 for 30 minutes for acme-demo-01 on /v1/embeddings.batch. That should absorb the import while keeping overall protection.

Anna: I’ll confirm a 30-minute temporary bump with Acme and log it in the deal notes. Quick approval from finance not required for this SE-led demo bump?

Sam: No finance sign-off for a 30m. I just need a ping here to proceed and I’ll apply it and post the override ID.

Maya: Customer ran reduced-concurrency test at 17:16 and reports no 429s during the 5-minute window. They can hold on the large import for a couple hours but would like the bump to finish the demo later today.

Jon: That’s a clear signal it’s quota/concurrency. Two follow-ups: 1) short-term: apply the 30m tokens_per_min override; 2) medium-term: recommend they switch to streaming or smaller batches and implement exponential backoff with Retry-After. Add to the POC doc a suggested batching profile for embeddings.

Sam: Applying override now. Override ID: ov-20260321-91. Applied at 17:20Z.

ops-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260321-91 applied for tenant acme-demo-01: /v1/embeddings.batch tokens_per_min=300000 duration_min=30 by Sam.

Maya: I’ve told Acme they can resume the import at 17:25. I’ll monitor and confirm whether any 429s reappear.

Anna: I’ll update the customer-facing POC checklist: note temporary override applied, recommended long-term config, and a note to include per-route concurrency limits in onboarding docs.

Jon: Also capture a small runbook entry for Sales/SEs: quick checklist to debug 429s in POCs — sample items: (1) ask for batch size/concurrency, (2) run reduced-concurrency test, (3) check per-route and tenant token charts in Console, (4) optional short override with infra, (5) advise permanent config change or batching.

Maya: Perfect. If 429s reappear I’ll re-open this thread. For now demo is green. :tada:

Sam: Closing monitoring window at 17:55Z. No further 429s observed in that period. I’ll revert override at 17:50Z to give them a cushion.

ops-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260321-91 scheduled end 17:50Z.

Anna: Thanks everyone — leaving a note in the CRM and follow-up with Acme to bake batching guidance into the integration plan.

Maya: Great work, team.
